_note: Symbol names, not line numbers. An earlier version of this file hardcoded line numbers read from the repo-root worktree (main) while the document is pinned to the branch base; that one file differs by 18 lines between the two trees, and the mismatch manufactured a false high-severity finding. Resolving by symbol is tree-independent, which is the only form of this check that cannot repeat that error.
_citation_rule: Every backend_registry.py:N cited by the document must land on a line that is not blank and not a bare comment, in the tree the document is pinned to. Anchors are NOT compared against any other tree.
